name: template-gallery-section
purpose: The templates band of a solution page: a framed media split whose copy side invites the reader to start from a template and whose media side is a two-column wall, scrolling once the band splits, of deployable template cards, closed by a marquee of the frameworks and clouds it works with. Each card is a mark, a title, one line and a deploy action. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'template-gallery-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `module`, `media-split`, `scroll-area`, `card-grid`, `button`, `registration-frame` and `marquee` rather than owning any anatomy of its own. With `closing` set it is the page's closing band: the hatched closing frame follows it, with no rules of its own, because the site footer under it opens with one (`hatch` turns that frame off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared one).
useWhen: Use TemplateGallerySection on marketing pages to show deployable templates; set `closing` when it is the last band.
On a solution page (Retail, Web Apps, AI Workloads, Security, Performance, Streaming) to show the templates a reader can deploy right away.
Whenever a band pairs one pitch with a long, browsable list of deployable starters.
avoidWhen: For a grid of features with artwork → use `feature-tiles-section`.
For a marquee of marks alone → compose `marquee` directly.
For a handful of icon-led use cases → use `customer-use-cases-section`.
For a closing ask with links or a command and no templates → use `closing-call-to-action-section`; for an email sign-up close → use `newsletter-section`.
related: `media-split` — the framed copy-and-media split the band is built on; it owns the band's named region.
`marquee` — the row of framework and cloud marks that closes the band.
bestPractices: Keep the wall to an even number of templates so the two columns end level.
Turn on `invertInDark` only for a mark whose artwork ships in dark ink, so it stays legible on the dark theme.
Set `templatesAriaLabel` so the scrolling wall is announced by name.

Set `closing` only on the last band of the page, right above `site-footer-section`: it draws the hatched closing frame itself, so nothing follows it inside the page column (no trailing `Spacer`, no closing `RegistrationFrame`).
Turn `hatch` off only on a closing band that another closing band follows directly; the last one keeps the frame.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the media split as its `h2` and naming its region.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: First button under the copy, drawn as the large secondary button; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.doc: Second button under the copy, drawn as the large outlined button; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: templates
props.doc: The template cards of the scrolling wall, in order; each is `{ title, description?, icon?, invertInDark?, href? }` where `href` makes the whole card a link to the template. Templates without a title are skipped.

props.name: deployLabel
props.doc: Label of the deploy button on each card; a card renders its button only when both this and its `href` are set.

props.name: templatesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the scrolling wall of templates.

props.name: marqueeLabel
props.doc: Eyebrow above the row of marks.

props.name: marqueeMarks
props.doc: Registry names of the frameworks and clouds in the row of marks, in order; the marquee is omitted when empty.

props.name: closing
props.doc: Makes the band the page's closing band: the hatched closing frame follows it, as the closing call to action draws it.

props.name: hatch
props.doc: Draws the hatched closing frame under a `closing` band; turn it off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared frame. Ignored without `closing`.
